task_completion.description: Open the Webots simulation and locate the 'MINING_ROBOT' node in the scene tree.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Webots application is open, and 'MINING_ROBOT' is visible in the Scene Tree on the left.

task_completion.description: Set the 'radio_emitter' Emitter node's range to 500 and channel to 7.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Scene Tree shows the 'radio_emitter' child of MINING_ROBOT selected, with the 'range' field set to 500 and 'channel' field set to 7 in the field editor.

task_completion.description: Set the 'status_display' Display node's width to 320 and height to 240.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Scene Tree shows the 'status_display' child of MINING_ROBOT selected, with 'width' set to 320 and 'height' set to 240 in the field editor.

task_completion.description: Add a Fog node at the world root level.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A 'Fog' node appears in the Scene Tree at the same level as the WorldInfo or Viewpoint nodes.

task_completion.description: Set Fog visibilityRange to 50.0 and fogType to 'EXPONENTIAL'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Fog node is selected; the field editor shows 'visibilityRange' as 50 and 'fogType' as 'EXPONENTIAL'.

task_completion.description: Save the world to the specified path: /home/ga/Desktop/mining_robot_configured.wbt.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Save World As...' dialog is shown with the path /home/ga/Desktop/mining_robot_configured.wbt, or the window title bar reflects the new filename.

integrity.description: The agent used the Webots GUI to modify node properties rather than just editing the text file via terminal.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with the Webots Scene Tree and Field Editor.

integrity.description: The agent did not simply create a dummy file using 'touch' or a text editor to bypass the simulation software.
integrity.visual_evidence: The agent is seen working within the Webots interface, not just a terminal or basic text editor.

integrity.description: The Fog node was added through the 'Add New' dialog in Webots.
integrity.visual_evidence: The 'Add a node' pop-up window is visible during the process of adding the Fog node.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The agent must configure the MINING_ROBOT in Webots. Required values: Emitter (range: 500, channel: 7), Display (width: 320, height: 240). A Fog node must be added at the root with visibilityRange: 50.0 and fogType: 'EXPONENTIAL'. The final file must be saved as /home/ga/Desktop/mining_robot_configured.wbt.
